title: 2026 Singlespeed Cyclocross World Championship Comes to Bellingham
content:
The Facilitators – a rare breed of cyclist in the mossy land of Bellingham: singlespeed enthusiasts – are putting together a gathering of like minded individuals. We are honored to convey their message and spread the prophecy: the 2026 Singlespeed Cyclocross World Championships is coming to Bellingham, WA this October.

Singlespeed Cyclocross World Championships

Summoned from the hallowed grounds of the maritime Chuckanut Mountains, called forth by the sacrifice of derailleurs and dignity, something stirs deep in the darkening forests where the Cascades plunge into the Salish Sea. All those brave and foolish enough to make the journey to the Northwestestest USA shall be welcomed with open arms and encouraged to surrender themselves to arduous challenge, ridiculous debauchery, and everlasting glory. Strengths will be feated and Champions will be annointed. This is the promise of the 2026 Singlespeed Cyclocross World Championship

Quick Hits

  • What: Singlespeed Cyclocross World Championships 2026 Bellingham (SSCXWC26BHAM)
  • When: October 2-4
  • Where: Bellingham, WA, USA
  • Who: You, and up to 499 of your closest, dumbest friends from around the world
  • Why: Because it’s the 20th anniversary (sort of) of the preeminent event for intentionally disabled road-ish bikes with miniature mtb tires that get ridden at speeds and in places they probably shouldn’t, by people who should definitely know better but still don’t, even after years and years of not learning… AKA Singlespeed Cyclocross.

What You Can Expect: Feats of Strength, Horsefoolery, and Zero Shifting

You are guaranteed a long weekend of riding bikes, getting rad, and the ultimate competition for the most important tattoo in cycling. Friday will present the lay of the land with a welcome ride that meanders through our world class trail riding networks, from beach to high scenic vistas and back. Welcome party that night at Transition HQ, with afters elsewhere courtesy of Outbound Lights. For Saturday’s Feats of Strength you will be sent on a quest of talent, dedication and willpower, to test your abilities on and off the bike and demonstrate your worthiness to compete in The Main Event. Blowout bash that night at The Evil Bikes Landing. Sunday is the big rowdy show: the Championship races go off, along with the Everybody’s A Winner(?) alternative lifestyle choices parade, at a race location unlike any you’ve experienced before. Got a gram of energy left? Comedown party at Structures Brewing! Every night there will be live music, food, beverages, and entertainment (hello fellow racers debasing themselves for the rights to host this mess in 2027).

How to Participate

No SSCX rig? No problem! Ziptied shifters, removed batteries, tracklocross, SSMTB, and just about anything else is welcomed, as long as it’s ridden in good faith. No one turned away for lack of the correct bike, although we might heckle you a little bit for that S-Works thing you turned up with. All levels and agendas are welcome, from pro racers on over to the camp and go slow club. Only mandatory thing is a willingness to get dirty.

We have a legendary race director. We have a community full of incredible venues and sublime shred-portals that will challenge skills you didn’t even know you had. We have deals and schemes to make your visit easy, from our wildly generous partners in Evil, Transition, Structures, Outbound, Kona, LOAM Equipment, WA Bike Law, and many more. A wholeass scholarship program for WTFNB and BIPoC riders! Cheap MTB rentals for the week before and after the race weekend! Bike shipping arrangements! Discounted hotels! Coffee! Beer! More! You will be taken care of, partied hard, and put away wet.

The only thing that’s still missing… is YOU, and the rest of your jerkoff SSCX team, and your other friends, and their friends, and everyone else that should definitely come party in the woods with all of us.

Of note, we, The Facilitators, have heard whispers that we can break 100 registrants in the women’s field. Help turn a whisper on the wind into fulfilled prophecy.

Come Have a Terrible Time

So what are you waiting for? Triflow up that clickin’ finger and head over to our wonderful website to learn more, get reg’d and make the best worst decision of your life. You’ll probably get beat buy a guy riding a Chamois Hagar with flats.

See you in October!

Singlespeedly,

The Facilitators

Check out the website and Instagram for more info, FAQs, and to register.
